bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 重回 10 日均线上方

read.en: Palantir rose 1.1% on Oct 26 to $198.84, trading between $192.91 and $200.05. It is above the falling 5-day ($197.2) and 10-day ($197.6) averages and the rising 30-day ($191.7), 100-day ($160.1) and 200-day ($153.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16 but is above zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($206.43), and RSI is 56.
read.zh: Palantir 10月26日上涨 1.1%，收于 $198.84，盘中区间 $192.91–200.05。股价位于下行的 5 日（$197.2）和 10 日均线（$197.6）以及上行的 30 日（$191.7）、100 日（$160.1）和 200 日均线（$153.3）上方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方，但仍在零轴上方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$206.43），RSI 为 56。

read.en: The close cleared the 10-day average, the $198.7 resistance, after a dip to $192.9; $200 capped the high. Resistance is $200–200.1, then $202.6–203.6 (Oct 16, 21 and 22 highs) and $206.4 (SAR). Support is $197.2–197.6 (5 and 10-day), then $189.4–191.7 (30-day, Oct 20, 21 and 23 lows) and $184.5. A close above $203.6 would open $206–213; a close below $189.4 would open $184.5.

r.zh: 抛物线 SAR；52周高点 $212.9（10月12日）
